lede: Chicago closed Week 8 with a 34-17 win in Seattle and Mark is two clear again on twenty. Below that the table has compressed into a scrum — two and a half points cover third through seventh, Bill and Harrison are dead level, and six of the eight owners have a full four games this week. Baltimore has no quarterback and plays Thursday, the Chargers still have no wins, and Harrison and Zach have been drawn against each other three separate times.

beats.text: Brian against Mark, and the Ravens have nobody to play quarterback. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve and needs surgery on the thumb he hurt on his only snap against Buffalo; Tyler Huntley is doubtful with turf toe. That leaves Joe Fagnano, an undrafted rookie who went 10-of-21 for 91 in relief on Sunday, took a low hit on the ankle, and was limited in Monday's walkthrough. Baltimore has lost three straight, is 0-3 against the spread at home, and is a nine-point home underdog to a Jacksonville side that ranks top five on both sides of the ball.

Bill's sweep and Harrison's steady two a week have left them tied for third, four and a half back. Bill has the week's widest spread of opponents — Cincinnati against Brian in Madrid at half past nine in the morning, Dallas at Indianapolis against Patrick, the Giants at Philadelphia against Anthony, and Tampa Bay at Chicago on Sunday night against Mark. Harrison drew Zach three times and Jon once, which is as close to a controlled experiment as this league gets.

beats.tag: Patrick and Brian · A point apart
beats.text: Patrick is on fifteen after Detroit ended Minnesota's unbeaten run 19-15 on 230 rushing yards, though Cleveland's five-and-one surge died in a 27-6 loss at Pittsburgh with Deshaun Watson sacked eight times. Brian is on fourteen and has Jacksonville, which is 5-2 and three games clear in the AFC South, plus Atlanta — shut out 16-0 by a Tampa Bay side that did not complete a single forward pass. Four games each, and they play each other in New Orleans.

The Broncos are 6-2 and first in the division after scoring fifteen unanswered in the fourth to beat Kansas City, ending it with Malcolm Roach sacking Patrick Mahomes on fourth down from the six. Arizona came from 17-3 down to win in overtime after benching Jacoby Brissett at halftime — Gardner Minshew starts from here. Anthony is on thirteen with four games, including the Jets against Jon's Chiefs and Philadelphia, where the Eagles have lost six straight without Jalen Hurts.

Ten points and last, but the schedule has handed him something: the Chargers host Houston, the Rams go to Washington and Green Bay goes to New England, so three of his four games are directly against Harrison. The problem is that the Chargers are 0-7, rank last in scoring, lead the league in turnovers and have not scored a touchdown since the third quarter of Week 5. The Rams and Packers are the ones that have to deliver.

beats.tag: The byes · Two teams, one owner
beats.text: Pittsburgh and Tennessee are the only two teams on bye in the entire league this week, and Jon owns both. That leaves him Kansas City on Sunday and Buffalo at Minnesota on Monday night — two games against six for most of the field. Mark has three, one of which is Las Vegas at San Francisco, where he owns both sidelines and banks a point before kickoff.
